title: CLAIM: Rothschilds own all the world's central banks
summary: Viral claim that the Rothschilds secretly own the Federal Reserve and most central banks. Counter-evidence: central banks are publicly/government-owned (Bank of England nationalized 1946; the Fed 'is not owned by anyone' — created by Congress). AAP FactCheck verdict: False. The trope traces to an anonymous 1846 Paris pamphlet and 'Protocols'-era literature.
